text: Being here, I am aware of the subtle yet profound energy of curiosity and creation. In the first space, the emptiness mingles with hushed human interaction, inviting contemplation. The second space vibrates with color and ideas, the language of research and design humming visually and textually on the walls. I feel both an observer and a participant in a continuous process of inquiry, where questions outweigh answers, and the future seems as malleable as fresh clay. There is promise here, and a call to engage with the unknown.
